system.description: You know a half hitch from a clove hitch, and the qualities of hemp vs. nylon. Sadly, this knowledge is mostly used to tie people up, but climbing and cattle-rustling work too. Make an Unopposed Skill Check. On Success, you rope the thing with a good knot.

upgrades.description: You can now use this Skill as an Attack, at a Range of 10ft vs. the target's Evade. On Success, the target gains the Held Debuff.
You can whip your line in that special way to untie a knot you made and recover your rope.
Your Attack now has a Range of your Strength (min 15).
